title: POST /api/broker/{broker}/login/start (200)
description: The consent URL that begins an in-app browser login for ONE broker. Source: src/brokerAuthRoutes.ts POST /api/broker/:broker/login/start success branch. Obtained via REAL HTTP with an inert BrokerLoginProvider. login_url is the broker's own consent page and carries only public values (the Kite api_key, or a single-use Dhan consent id) plus, for Zerodha, the single-use state nonce — NEVER an app secret, a checksum or an access token. expires_at is when the pending-login entry stops being claimable, so the UI can tell the operator the attempt has lapsed.
